claim_text: AFP says it was hit by a cyberattack aimed at AFP Forum
summary: Agence France-Presse's management says the agency was hit by a cyberattack overnight on Nov 25-26, aimed at AFP Forum, one of the platforms its clients use to browse and download its content.
detail: AFP said so in a statement carried by its own dispatch and in an internal email from management quoted by Anadolu and Al Jazeera.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The dispatch quotes AFP: "L'AFP a été la cible d'une cyberattaque cette nuit, à partir de 1h30 (heure de Paris). Elle visait AFP Forum"; Anadolu quotes the same in management's internal email.

claim_text: The attack began at 1:30 am Paris time on Nov 26
summary: AFP says the attack started at 1:30 am Paris time (00:30 GMT) on Thursday, Nov 26.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The dispatch: "à partir de 1h30 (heure de Paris)", in the night from Wednesday to Thursday; Al Jazeera: "starting at 1:30 am (Paris time) [00:30 GMT]".

claim_text: AFP took AFP Forum offline when it found the intrusion and the platform is still unavailable
summary: AFP says its teams isolated AFP Forum as soon as the intrusion was found and that the platform stays unavailable until further notice. At 11:27 PM ET on Nov 26 its front page showed only an "Under maintenance" notice.
detail: AFP has given no date for its return.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: AFP: "AFP Forum reste donc temporairement inaccessible"; the internal email: "AFP Forum remains unavailable until further notice"; afpforum.com shows "En maintenance • Under maintenance".

claim_text: AFP is offering its subscribers other ways to get its content while AFP Forum is down
summary: AFP says it is offering its subscribers fallback solutions while AFP Forum stays offline.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The dispatch: "Des solutions de repli sont proposées aux abonnés de l'agence"; Anadolu: AFP "was providing alternative solutions to subscribers".

claim_text: AFP is investigating with outside experts and says it does not know who was behind the attack
summary: AFP says analysis is under way with outside experts and that, so far, it has no information on who carried out the attack.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: AFP: "Des analyses sont en cours, avec l'appui d'experts extérieurs. À ce stade, nous ne disposons d'aucun élément sur l'identité des auteurs de cette attaque".

claim_text: AFP is one of the three global news agencies, with AP and Reuters
summary: AFP is one of the world's three global news agencies, with AP and Reuters. It employs about 1,840 journalists in 210 bureaus and supplies news in six languages, as text, photos and video.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The dispatch: "L'AFP est l'une des trois agences mondiales d'information, avec AP et Reuters. Elle emploie 1.840 journalistes ... à travers 210 bureaux" and supplies news "en six langues, en texte, photo, vidéo".
